value.title: Стрелка направления и магнитный азимут
value.meaning: With compass, arrow is relative magnetic direction; without compass it compensates absolute true target bearing by camera bearing. Numeric target azimuth stays magnetic.
value.value_origin: True target bearing -> WMM+saved correction -> magnetic bearing; subtract device magnetic heading or camera bearing in respective branches
value.units: Clockwise degrees: true, magnetic and screen-relative references distinct.
actions: Rotate camera without compass; adjust correction.
conditions: Valid guidance result/current mode; compass availability chooses reference frame.
value.saved_state: Correction persists; arrow/target bearing recomputed without geometry mutation.
expectations: Without compass, camera+90 changes screen arrow-90 while numeric target magnetic azimuth stays constant.
Counterexample: arrow rotation is not numeric absolute magnetic bearing.
